pattern_name_ar: الأرقام و there is/are وحروف الوقت (at/in/on)
formula: There is + singular   |   There are + plural   |   at TIME · on DAY · in MONTH/YEAR
when_to_use: Use there is / there are to say that something exists, and at/on/in to place events in time.
when_to_use_ar: نستخدم there is/are للتعبير عن وجود شيء، و at/on/in لتحديد الوقت.
why_arabic_speakers_struggle: Arabic uses 'يوجد/في' for existence without number agreement, so is/are gets mixed. Arabic also uses 'في' for almost every time expression, while English splits it into at, on and in.

examples.en: There are seven days in a week.
The class is at three o'clock.
There is a book on the table.

common_errors.wrong: The class is in three o'clock.
common_errors.correct: The class is at three o'clock.

practice_fill_blank.sentence: There ___ twelve months in a year.
There ___ one kitchen in my house.

quick_rule: AT a clock time · ON a day/date · IN a month/year. There IS + one, there ARE + many.
quick_rule_ar: AT للساعة، ON لليوم، IN للشهر/السنة. و there is للمفرد و there are للجمع.
mnemonic: Smallest to biggest: AT (time) → ON (day) → IN (month).
connect_to_speaking: Say your schedule: 'There are five lessons. My class is at nine on Sunday.'
